description:
## Problem

Two documentation defects recorded as deferred advisories during epic b7157be6 (NOTE-03, NOTE-11), both repo-wide rather than epic-scoped.

### 1. The workspace README omits `gf2-sim`

`README.md`'s Workspace layout table lists `gf2-core`, `gf2-coding`, `gf2-stats`, `gf2-algebra`, `gf2-kernels-simd`, `gf2-kernels-hip`, and `proofs/`, but not `gf2-sim` — even though the file carries a `gf2-sim` coverage badge at `README.md:7` and the crate owns the CPU/GPU simulation pipeline, the campaign runners, and the OSD campaign protocol. A reader of the workspace table cannot discover the crate.

### 2. `@/issue/<short-id>` looks like a resolvable address and is not

`.jit/config.toml` declares seven item kinds — `requirement`, `decision`, `risk`, `invariant`, `rule`, `citation`, `gate` — and `issue` is not among them, so `@/issue/<short-id>` resolves for no issue whatsoever. The form nonetheless mimics the resolvable `@/<kind>/<self-id>` addresses (`@/inv/…`, `@/citation/…`) that do resolve, which is why two independent gate runs have now reported it as a dangling reference.

The repository's dominant prose convention for the same purpose carries no such implication: plain backticked short-id, as in ``JIT issue `c7e91dfd` `` (`crates/gf2-core/docs/QUALITY_AUDIT_PLAN.md:5`, `dev/active/b8206228-permanent-statistics/freeze-feasibility-draft.md:3`).

Current `@/issue/` uses: `AGENTS.md:48`, `crates/gf2-core/src/alg/rref.rs:599`, `crates/gf2-sim/Cargo.toml:28`, `crates/gf2-sim/src/osd_campaign.rs:664`, `:666`. The last three were added during epic b7157be6 following the `rref.rs` precedent; their targets all exist, so this is a form question rather than a broken-link question, and the gf2-sim sites sit in code certified by a passed `code-review`.

An earlier note in that epic withdrew this item on the grounds that the cited issues exist. That withdrawal was wrong: existence was never the complaint.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The workspace layout table in `README.md` carries a `gf2-sim` row describing the crate's purpose, consistent in style with the surrounding rows and checked against `crates/gf2-sim/src/lib.rs` and `AGENTS.md`.
- [hard] REQ-02: One convention for referencing a JIT issue from prose and rustdoc is decided and recorded where the repository's authoring conventions live, stating whether `@/issue/<short-id>` is adopted (which requires an `issue` item kind that resolves) or retired in favour of the backticked short-id form.
- [hard] REQ-03: Every existing `@/issue/` site is brought to the decided convention in the same change, or listed with the reason it is exempt.
title: Workspace README omits the gf2-sim crate from its layout table
